item.title: The time is NOW for Alabama! 🕒 Are they UNDER THE RADAR? with On3's JAKE CRAIN!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: Fall camp is underway, and we've got BIG questions! What happens if Alabama goes 9-3 this season? Do they make the playoff? Do fans freak out? Will the Crimson Tide get their swagger back in 2026? What does it mean if Kalen DeBoer picks Austin Mack over Keelon Russell for the QB job? Jake Crain of On3 and the Crain & Cone podcast answers these questions and more about the upcoming Bama season.
